notes.title: Update 105 is Live ! (new save system)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi guys as I reminded you I had to change the way the game saves and there was no way to convert the old saves to the new  system. 
It sucks that you lost your progress but I am sure that you will catch up in no time, and that you might discover some alternative paths while you replay.[/h1]

[b]Whats new:[/b]

Redesigned HUD: Better performance , shows more information  
New save system implemented allows for saving individual items health or state(on/off) and more... 
Improved quests
Fixed audio bugs
Updated some levels
